items.reason: The claimed regression is absent: RolePermissions.java:392 and :475-480 already apply manage-clients authorization before checking composite permissions, and :432 does likewise for client-scope mappings. Ordinary role mapping uses manage-users authorization at RolePermissions.java:302, not manage-clients. The base implementation also lacks manage-clients shortcuts in ClientPermissions.java:536-557, :613-632 and :635-654, contradicting the claimed V1 behavior.
